issues.title: [vllm, hardware] refactor: drop obsolete vLLM-Ascend NPU patch shims for vllm-ascend v0.30.0
issues.body:
### What does this PR do?

Target **vLLM-Ascend 0.30** instead of 0.23 and shrink the NPU patch layer to what 0.30 still needs.

**1. Drop the shims whose fixes are already upstream in vLLM-Ascend 0.30 / vLLM 0.30**

- DeepSeek V4 hash-routing `__init__` override — 0.30's `DeepseekV4MoE` builds `tid2eid` as `(token_ids + expert_offsets) % n_routed_experts` natively (same table the patch wrote).
- DeepSeek V4 expert `weight_loader` restore in `load_weights` — 0.30's `replace_parameter()` documents that `weight_loader` is always taken from the existing parameter.
- GLM-5.2 SFA `kv_b_proj` keep-alive — 0.30 gates `dispose_layer(self.kv_b_proj)` behind `rl_weight_update_enabled` (#15463).
- GLM-5.2 SFA indexer scale — 0.30 moved the indexer to `vllm_ascend/attention/indexer*.py`; the old `indexer_select_post_process` target no longer exists (the patch would have failed closed).
- vLLM partial wake-up / DP dummy-batch patch and its `run_engine_core` entry point — vLLM 0.30 already skips executor/dummy-batch work while asleep.
- Legacy `FusedMoE` class-level `weight_loader` transpose wrapper — 0.30 only exposes the `FusedMoEFactory` function, and the layout transpose is owned by the Ascend `process_weights_after_loading`.
- `CaMemAllocator.sleep` synchronize wrapper — vllm-ascend 0.30 synchronizes before unmapping tensor memory itself.

**2. Retarget the remaining patches to 0.30** (`13330bfc`)

- Version gate `0.23.0 <= vllm < 0.24.0` → `0.30.0 <= vllm < 0.31.0`; `v023_*` / `vllm013_*` entry points renamed to `v030_*`.
- DeepSeek V4: import `AscendDeepseekV4ForCausalLM` from `vllm_ascend.models.deepseek_v4.model`. 0.30 ships the model as a package with an empty `__init__.py`, and `apply_npu_vllm_patches()` runs at `import verl.utils.vllm`, so the old package-root import raised `ImportError` in every NPU process. The Transformers → Ascend rename is still required: 0.30's `load_weights` resolves names through `params_dict[name]` without a fallback.
- GLM-5.2 RMSNorm: drop the `torch.ops.vllm.maybe_chunk_residual` call (the op is gone in 0.30) and require the bias-aware `npu_add_rms_norm_bias` source shape before patching; stop importing `vllm_ascend.patch.worker.patch_routed_experts_capture`, which 0.30 applies itself from `vllm_ascend.utils.adapt_patch`.
- FIA decode mask: keep the source-level rewrite; both anchor blocks still match the 0.30 `full_graph_fia` / `forward_fused_infer_attention` sources exactly once.
- Rotary embedding: forward `enforce_enable` to `CustomOp.__init__`, which takes it keyword-only in 0.30.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Queries used / to run:
  - https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+npu_vllm_patch
  - https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+vllm-ascend+0.30
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` — proposed: `[vllm, hardware] refactor: support vLLM-Ascend 0.30 in the NPU patch layer`

### Test

- `python -m pytest tests/utils/test_npu_vllm_patch_on_cpu.py -q` → **40 passed**
- `pre-commit run --files verl/utils/vllm/npu_vllm_patch.py tests/utils/test_npu_vllm_patch_on_cpu.py` → `ruff`, `ruff format`, `mypy`, license / docstring / naming / compileall hooks pass. (`autogen-trainer-cfg` skipped locally because `hydra-core` is not installed in this environment; unrelated to these files.)
- FIA rewrite checked statically against `vllm_ascend/attention/attention_v1.py` @ `vllm-ascend v0.30.0`: each anchor block matches exactly once, and the rewritten method sources compile.
- Device validation before merging: DeepSeek-V4 weight sync, FIA FULL-graph decode, and GLM-5.2 numerics with `VERL_VLLM_ASCEND_GLM52_PATCH=1` — including a quantization config that carries a norm bias.

### API and Usage Example

No public API, CLI or config change. `apply_npu_vllm_patches()` keeps its signature and still runs when `verl.utils.vllm` is imported; only the set of patches it applies changes, and those patches are internal to the NPU rollout path.

```python
# unchanged call site: importing verl.utils.vllm applies the NPU patches
from verl.utils.vllm import apply_npu_vllm_patches  # already called at import time
```

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/utils/vllm/npu_vllm_patch.py` — removes seven 0.23-era shims and their helpers; keeps three patches (DeepSeek V4 name/loader wrapper, FIA decode mask, ARM `sched_yield`) plus the env-gated GLM-5.2 block, now gated on `0.30.0 <= vllm < 0.31.0`.
- `tests/utils/test_npu_vllm_patch_on_cpu.py` — drops the `FusedMoE`-factory cases, retargets the dispatch test to vLLM `0.30.0`, and renames it to `test_apply_npu_vllm_patches_installs_every_patch`; DeepSeek V4 name-mapping / lazy-consumption tests are unchanged.
- Behavioural scope: only the NPU vLLM rollout path is affected. Settings that keep the old behaviour: `VERL_VLLM_ASCEND_GLM52_PATCH` (opt-in) still gates the GLM-5.2 block.

issues.title: [vllm,sglang] feat: Support LoRA for DeepSeek V4 & DeepSeek V4.1 & GLM5.3 Flash
issues.body: ### What does this PR do? Depends on: - https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51368 - https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52552 - https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52626 - https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53361 - https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56327 - https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6044 - https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6199 - https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7054 - https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7521 - https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7522 - https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/8018 - https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7763 - https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7762 - https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7500 - https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7501 - https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7502 - https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7503 - https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7678 Adds DeepSeek V4, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM5.3 Flash LoRA support to verl's vLLM weight-sync path. Previously a merge=False LoRA base sync orphaned the `.base_layer.` suffix on wrapped modules and mishandled the mxfp4 quant path, so DSV4 LoRA diverged from the actor. This reworks weight-name reconciliation to be runtime-probed (strict vs flat loader) instead of model-type-based, unwraps the LoRA-installed mxfp4 quant-method wrapper, and threads `peft_config` through the FP8/mxfp4 load path so the same reconciliation applies there. Tested with Megatron backend, GPU E2E (DSV4 merge=F GRPO, 2-node): step1/step2 pearson 0.9970/0.9950, aligned to run15 merge=T 0.9952/0.9944. ### Checklist Before Starting - [X] Search for similar PRs. Query: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=deepseek+v4+lora - [X] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI) - `{modules}` include `fsdp`, `megatron`, `veomni`, `sglang`, `vllm`, `rollout`, `trainer`, `ci`, `training_utils`, `recipe`, `hardware`, `deployment`, `ray`, `worker`, `single_controller`, `misc`, `perf`, `model`, `algo`, `env`, `tool`, `ckpt`, `doc`, `data`, `cfg`, `reward`, `fully_async`, `one_step_off` - If this PR involves multiple modules, separate them with `,` like `[megatron, fsdp, doc]` - `{type}` is in `feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `chore`, `test` - If this PR breaks any API (CLI arguments, config, function signature, etc.), add `[BREAKING]` to the beginning of the title. - Example: `[BREAKING][fsdp, megatron] feat: dynamic batching` ### Test ```bash pytest tests/utils/test_vllm_weight_name_normalization_on_cpu.py # GPU E2E: DSV4 merge=F GRPO 2-node — step1/step2 pearson 0.9970/0.9950 vs run15 merge=T 0.9952/0.9944 ``` Unit tests cover strict-vs-flat loader detection, per-expert routed leaves, and non-LoRA params on wrapped modules (e.g. DSV4 `gate.tid2eid` / `gate.e_score_correction_bias`). ### API and Usage Example For GLM-5.3-Flash, prepare every Ray node with a Bridge build providing `GLM53FlashModel` and its paired Megatron-Core, then launch with `VERL_USE_UV=0`. The frozen `megatron` extra pins Bridge 0.6.2, which lacks this wrapper. DSW CPU import checks passed against both the documented upstream source pair (Bridge `58382ddf`, Core `902feb8e`) and the separate Bridge `d16c26d5` environment used for GLM training. [Per-node setup and import check](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/cd9330c25a9408aeedc87a5abfb88562e9318a05/examples/tuning/lora/run_glm53_flash_megatron.sh#L12-L19) No CLI/API change. Behavior is automatic: `resolve_weight_name` probes the inner model's `load_weights` at runtime and toggles `.base_layer.` accordingly. For DSV4 merge=False LoRA, no extra config is needed beyond enabling LoRA + `merge=False`. ```bash # DSV4 merge=False LoRA (existing config; no new flags) actor_rollout_ref.model.lora.enable=True actor_rollout_ref.model.lora.merge=False actor_rollout_ref.model.lora.target_modules='["linear_wkv","linear_wgate","linear_wq_b","linear_weights_proj","linear_kv_proj","linear_q_down_proj","linear_q_up_proj","linear_proj","linear_fc1","linear_fc2","router"]' ``` ### Design & Code Changes **Runtime-probed `.base_layer.` reconciliation** (`verl/utils/vllm/utils.py`) - Adds `_inner_load_weights_is_strict`: probes the inner transformer's `load_weights` bytecode (`co_names`) to decide strict (keeps `.base_layer.`, DeepseekV2/DSV4) vs flat (strips it, Llama/Qwen3.5). Cached per class. - `resolve_weight_name` toggles one `.base_layer.` segment loader-style-aware, re-adds the suffix for non-LoRA params on a wrapped module, and reconciles per-expert routed leaves (strict keep / flat strip, gated by `_HAS_LORA_BASE_LAYER_PREFIX`). **mxfp4 LoRA unwrap** (`verl/utils/vllm/vllm_fp4_utils.py`) - Adds `_resolve_mxfp4_quant_method`: unwraps the `FusedMoEModularMethod` wrapper that merge=False LoRA installs over `Mxfp4MoEMethod` (stored as `old_quant_method`) so staging, layout derivation, and `process_weights_after_loading` repack reach the legacy method — the modular wrapper inherits a no-op post-load and would otherwise skip the repack. **FP8/mxfp4 name reconciliation** (`verl/utils/vllm/vllm_quant_utils.py`, `verl/workers/rollout/vllm_rollout/utils.py`) - `load_quanted_weights` gains a `peft_config` parameter; when set (LoRA base sync), names run through `resolve_weight_name` against live params/buffers so `.base_layer.` is reconciled on the FP8/mxfp4 path too (e.g. DSV4 `compressor.fused_wkv_wgate`). Callers thread `peft_config` for both base and drafter loads. **LoRA MoE prefix** (`verl/utils/vllm/patch.py`) - Removes the eager `lora_base_layer_prefix` clearing block; the prefix is now reconciled through `resolve_weight_name` instead. **Tests** (`tests/utils/test_vllm_weight_name_normalization_on_cpu.py`) - Expanded coverage for strict-vs-flat loader detection, per-expert routed leaves, and non-LoRA params on wrapped modules. ### Checklist Before Submitting > [!IMPORTANT] > Please check all the following items before requesting a review, otherwise the reviewer might deprioritize this PR for review. - [X] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). - [X] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting): `pre-commit install && pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always` - [X] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs). - [X] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to [the CI workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/.github/workflows) to cover all the code. If not feasible, explain why: ... - [X] Once your PR is ready for CI, send a message in [the `ci-request` channel](https://verl-project.slack.com/archives/C091TCESWB1) in [the `verl` Slack workspace](https://join.slack.com/t/verl-project/shared_invite/zt-3855yhg8g-CTkqXu~hKojPCmo7k_yXTQ). (If not accessible, please try [the Feishu group (飞书群)](https://applink.larkoffice.com/client/chat/chatter/add_by_link?link_token=772jd4f1-cd91-441e-a820-498c6614126a).) - [X] If your PR is related to the `recipe` submodule, please also update the reference to the submodule commit via `git submodule update --remote` or `cd recipe && git pull origin main`. ✨ Presented to you with [Mind Lab](https://www.mindlab.im/) - A Lab for Experiential Intelligence.
